title: Roz ek sawaal, do raaste
caption:
Sach bol kar dost khona, ya chup reh kar dosti bachaana: aap kya chunenge? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a hostel student who answers Waypoint's one two-option question each day and, the next day, sees how everyone else answered. Waypoint is for adults 18 and over and is not a counselling or crisis service.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Ananya: Ananya is a woman of about twenty-one with a long braid, a yellow kurti and round glasses.
cast.Tara: Tara is Ananya's hostel roommate, a woman of about twenty-one with short hair and a maroon hoodie.

scenes.vo: सच बोलूँ, तो दोस्त जाएगा। चुप रहूँ, तो दोस्ती झूठी।
scenes.sub: Sach boloon, toh dost jaayega. Chup rahoon, toh dosti jhoothi.
scenes.art: Ananya sitting on a hostel bed with her knees drawn up, looking at her phone with a troubled, thoughtful face, fairy lights on the wall.

scenes.vo: अनन्या पूरी शाम इसी में उलझी रही।
scenes.sub: Ananya poori shaam isi mein uljhi rahi.
scenes.art: Ananya at a hostel study desk with open books, not reading, staring out of the window at dusk.

scenes.vo: तारा ने पूछा, क्या हुआ? वह बोली, कुछ नहीं।
scenes.sub: Tara ne poochha, kya hua? Woh boli, kuch nahi.
scenes.art: Tara looking up from her own bed with a concerned face, Ananya shaking her head.

scenes.vo: कभी कभी अपनी उलझन बतानी मुश्किल होती है।
scenes.sub: Kabhi kabhi apni uljhan bataani mushkil hoti hai.
scenes.art: Ananya alone on the hostel balcony at night with a cup of tea, city lights far away.

scenes.vo: उस रात वेपॉइंट पर रोज़ का सवाल आया।
scenes.sub: Us raat Waypoint par roz ka sawaal aaya.
scenes.art: Ananya's face lit by her phone as she sits on the balcony step, curious.

scenes.vo: एक सवाल। दो रास्ते। बस एक बार चुनना था।
scenes.sub: Ek sawaal. Do raaste. Bas ek baar chunna tha.

scenes.vo: अगले दिन दिखा कि बाक़ी सब ने क्या चुना।
scenes.sub: Agle din dikha ki baaqi sab ne kya chuna.

scenes.vo: आधे लोग उसकी तरह सोचते थे। आधे बिलकुल उल्टा।
scenes.sub: Aadhe log uski tarah sochte the. Aadhe bilkul ulta.
scenes.art: Ananya smiling in surprise at her phone in the hostel corridor in morning light.

scenes.vo: उसे लगा, उलझन सिर्फ़ उसकी नहीं थी।
scenes.sub: Use laga, uljhan sirf uski nahi thi.
scenes.art: Ananya walking across a sunny college lawn with lighter steps, books in her arm.

scenes.vo: शाम को उसने तारा से बात शुरू की।
scenes.sub: Shaam ko usne Tara se baat shuru ki.
scenes.art: Ananya and Tara sitting side by side on a hostel bed, talking, two cups of tea between them.

scenes.vo: अब दोनों रोज़ का सवाल साथ में खोलती हैं।
scenes.sub: Ab dono roz ka sawaal saath mein kholti hain.
scenes.art: Ananya and Tara laughing together over one phone on the hostel balcony.

scenes.vo: आज के सवाल में आप क्या चुनते?
scenes.sub: Aaj ke sawaal mein aap kya chunte?
scenes.art: Close-up of Ananya smiling at the viewer, fairy lights softly blurred behind.
